svg.title: Evidence you can inspect
svg.desc: Private development build, frozen question set v6: on 990 new questions (495 Polish, 495 English) GEL RAM at its balanced setting gave 447 correct answers, each with its source passage, 18 wrong and 525 UNKNOWN. Two BM25 search engines on the same bank and rule gave 588–616 correct and 33–36 wrong: they find more answers, GEL RAM gives fewer wrong ones. At the precise setting GEL RAM gave 313 correct and 2 wrong, the engines at their strict threshold 414–417 correct and 4–5 wrong, so there the engines find more answers. Every recorded answer is re-scored by the public verify run; the build itself is private.
svg.text: PRIVATE DEVELOPMENT BUILD · QUESTION SET V6 · 990 QUESTIONS · 495 POLISH, 495 ENGLISH · ONE RUN
